title: Server Health Check
description: Run a consolidated Linux health check covering CPU, memory, disk, load, uptime, and key services.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "========================================"
echo "        SERVER HEALTH CHECK"
echo "========================================"

echo
echo "Hostname:"
hostname

echo
echo "Uptime:"
uptime -p

echo
echo "Load Average:"
awk '{print "1m="$1, "5m="$2, "15m="$3}' /proc/loadavg

echo
echo "CPU Usage:"
top -bn1 | awk '/Cpu\(s\)/ {printf "%.2f%%\n", 100 - $8}'

echo
echo "Memory Usage:"
free -h

echo
echo "Root Disk:"
df -h /

echo
echo "Root Inodes:"
df -ih /

echo
echo "Failed Systemd Units:"
systemctl --failed --no-legend || true

echo
echo "Health check completed."
